hooks.text: 繁育时会混合双亲特征，生成能力与外观都不同的独一史莱姆伙伴
hooks.excerpt: Discover endless possibilities as you breed different slimes, combining traits from both parents to create new, one-of-a-kind slime companions with unique abilities and appearances.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 通过喂养、提升属性和解锁能力培养史莱姆，照料质量直接决定队伍能否扛过生存挑战
hooks.excerpt: Strengthen your slimes by feeding them, raising their stats, and unlocking new abilities. Proper care is essential for building a powerful team that can endure the challenges of survival.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次岛屿旅程都会重新生成挑战、敌人和奖励，让史莱姆队持续探索下一座岛
hooks.excerpt: Prepare your slime team for an ever-evolving island survival adventure, where every journey is unique. Face procedurally generated challenges, enemies, and rewards as you explore island after island.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
